title: Alibaba Qwen Officially Announces the All-New Generation Qwen4 Large Model: Major Advances Across Multiple Dimensions, Preview Version Officially Launched
excerpt: Alibaba officially announced today that its new-generation Qwen large model, Qwen4, is about to be fully released. As an iterative upgrade of its core architect
content_html:
Alibaba officially announced today that its new-generation Qwen large model, Qwen4, is about to be fully released. As an iterative upgrade of its core architecture, the new-generation model has achieved all-round advancements in the depth of knowledge understanding, multi-dimensional world perception, and core capabilities such as Coding (programming) and Agentic (intelligent agent).

Preview Version Launches First, Multiple Official Apps Integrate Simultaneously

With the official announcement, the Qwen4-Max preview version has already landed on Alibaba Token Plan and launched a limited-time trial promotion with discounts up to 90% off. The regular starting price for the Personal Lite and Essential editions is 39 yuan/month, and new customers can enjoy an additional 50% off on top of that, bringing it down to as low as 19.5 yuan.

Meanwhile, to allow developers and ordinary users to experience the performance of the new model as soon as possible, multiple core official products and applications, including Qwen Office, Qoder, Qwen App, and QwenStudio, have also fully integrated the new Qwen4 model at the earliest opportunity.
